implementation_status: Protocol only; no pilot trainer or active-unlabeled manifest created. Legacy coupled Endo-SemiS trainer is not a substitute for this one-factor pilot
failed_condition: fiber_provisional_train_precision: observed0.9412222556995079 below frozen0.95; not a verified clinical error rate

data.source_policy: kidney_stones_fiber_v1 only; stone_new banned; validation videos and all derivatives never train

initialization.mode: new paired experiment from same pure-kidney supervised weights; reset optimizer, scheduler, AMP and RNG; never resume with changed losses

shared_training.supervised_loss: weighted CE plus foreground Dice; original provisional background retained

fixed_sparse_pseudo.unlabeled_sampling: independent seeded shuffle each epoch;95 batches per epoch; save generator state
fixed_sparse_pseudo.pseudo_source: new versioned frozen teacher-consensus artifact only after readiness passes; diagnostic masks are not a training dataset
fixed_sparse_pseudo.loss: class-balanced masked CE on strong photometric view, with geometric transforms applied identically to image and static mask
fixed_sparse_pseudo.background_pixel_cap: at most4x accepted foreground pixels per batch, seeded selection
fixed_sparse_pseudo.no_foreground_batch_policy: skip unsupervised term; keep supervised update

selection: Fixed final epoch5 versus matched supervised control; frozen joint gates; selected epochs diagnostic only
stop_conditions: Fail readiness: no pilot launch, no threshold relaxation after seeing results
Any nonfinite loss or changed input/source/checkpoint identity: stop immediately
Compared with same-epoch supervised control, fiber Dice drops by>0.02 or stone Recall by>0.05 for two consecutive epochs: stop and retain diagnosis
Accepted stone or fiber pseudo supervision absent for two consecutive epochs: stop
No automatic extension beyond fixed5 epochs
limitations: All numbers are development protocol choices, not clinical acceptance criteria; repeated29-frame validation and provisional source labels remain limited. No teacher accuracy inferred from reserve coverage or confidence
